facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She screamed for help. A hunter was nearby. He heard her voice. The hunter came.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood screamed as loud as she could. The wolf was getting closer and closer to her. Luckily, a brave hunter was walking in the forest. He heard the screaming and ran to the cottage. The hunter came and burst through the door. The wolf froze when he saw the strong hunter.
